authority: CEO Round 159: 'Before any result changes candidate state: PRE_REGISTRATION_VALID AND IMPLEMENTATION_MATCHES_PROTOCOL AND BASELINE_FAIR AND NO_DATA_LEAKAGE AND THRESHOLDS_FROZEN AND MODEL_SPECIFICATION_FROZEN AND RANDOM_SEED/COHORT_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE. If any are false: EXPERIMENT_INVALID and candidate posterior unchanged. This should become a constitutional invariant.'
constitutional_basis: Article I — evidence precedes assertion (invalid evidence is not evidence)
Article IV — no fallback epistemology (cannot use invalid results as fallback)
Article VII — never weaken the verifier to rescue a claim (cannot weaken the validity gate)
Article XIV — no research proceeds through a red gate (invalid experiment = RED gate)
Article XIX — never optimize for the gate (frozen parameters are the validity check)
Article XXVIII — no silent semantic promotion (cannot promote invalid to valid)
Article XXIX — separate implementation failure from mechanism failure
Article XXXIII — no irreversible action on unresolved evidence
purpose: Round 158 proved that the system needs a MECHANICAL validity gate, not a procedural one. The C2-Y and C3-X experiments passed procedural review (the coder wrote pre-registrations) but failed mechanical review (parameters were tuned after pre-registration, implementation did not match specification). This artifact defines the 7-condition validity gate that MUST pass before any experiment result can update candidate belief. This is proposed as a constitutional invariant — future rounds should amend the Epistemic Constitution to include Article XXXVI (Experiment Validity Gate).

1_PRE_REGISTRATION_VALID.description: A pre-registration file exists, is hash-pinned, and was committed BEFORE the experiment script was executed.
mechanical_check: Pre-registration file exists at canonical path (e.g., C2_Y_R1_PREREGISTRATION_V2.json)
Pre-registration file SHA-256 is recorded in the hash registry
Pre-registration file commit timestamp is BEFORE experiment execution timestamp
Pre-registration file was not modified between commit and execution (hash matches)
1_PRE_REGISTRATION_VALID.failure_mode: If pre-registration is missing, unpinned, or modified after commit → EXPERIMENT_INVALID
1_PRE_REGISTRATION_VALID.round_158_violation: C2-Y-R1 and C3-X-R1 pre-registrations existed but did not contain ALL parameters (alarm thresholds, MPC gain were missing)

2_IMPLEMENTATION_MATCHES_PROTOCOL.description: The experiment script implements EXACTLY what the pre-registration specifies. No substitution of algorithms (e.g., UKF → exponential smoothing), no simplification of models, no skipped components.
mechanical_check: Every algorithm specified in pre-registration is implemented (e.g., UKF, MPC, Bayesian TDM)
Implementation matches specification (e.g., UKF has sigma points, process noise, measurement noise — not just exponential smoothing)
No silent substitution (e.g., 'Kalman filter' in comments but actually a low-pass filter)
Code review by second party OR automated specification-to-implementation diff
2_IMPLEMENTATION_MATCHES_PROTOCOL.failure_mode: If implementation does not match specification → EXPERIMENT_INVALID. Per Article XXIX, this is an IMPLEMENTATION failure, not a MECHANISM failure.
2_IMPLEMENTATION_MATCHES_PROTOCOL.round_158_violation: C3-X-R1 specified UKF but implemented exponential smoothing. This is a specification violation.

3_BASELINE_FAIR.description: The baseline is the strongest publicly plausible alternative, not a strawman. Baseline parameters are pre-registered and frozen. Baseline implementation is calibrated against published performance.
mechanical_check: Baseline is sourced from publicly demonstrated capabilities (PMID, FDA 510(k), SEC filings)
Baseline parameters are pre-registered and frozen
Baseline reproduction fidelity is verified (within 20% of published performance)
No silent weakening of baseline (e.g., reducing sampling frequency, using poorer parameters than published)
Baseline has access to the SAME information stream as the candidate (no unfair information advantage)
3_BASELINE_FAIR.failure_mode: If baseline is strawman, uncalibrated, or weakened → EXPERIMENT_INVALID
3_BASELINE_FAIR.round_158_violation: C2-Y-R1: UISB baseline was not calibrated against VIEshunt-published response. C3-X-R1: Baseline B used simplified posterior (not full Bayesian NONMEM).

4_NO_DATA_LEAKAGE.description: The candidate does not have access to information that the baseline lacks. Train/test split is pre-registered and enforced. No post-hoc data selection.
mechanical_check: Candidate and baseline receive the SAME sensor data stream
Candidate may extract different features, but cannot receive additional sensors
Train/test split is pre-registered (e.g., 60/40) and enforced in code
No patient exclusion without pre-registered criteria
No cherry-picking of failure modes or patient subgroups
4_NO_DATA_LEAKAGE.failure_mode: If candidate has information advantage or data is leaked → EXPERIMENT_INVALID
4_NO_DATA_LEAKAGE.round_158_violation: C2-Y-R1: candidate used response-manifold features that baselines did not (this is the invention being tested, so acceptable — but must be explicitly documented as asymmetric by design).

5_THRESHOLDS_FROZEN.description: All decision thresholds (WIN, KILL, MMD) are pre-registered with provenance chains. No threshold is changed after experiment execution.
mechanical_check: WIN/KILL/MMD thresholds are in the pre-registration file
Each threshold has provenance (CLINICAL/ENGINEERING/MODEL_DERIVED/etc.) per Article XXVII
Threshold file is hash-pinned
No threshold changed between pre-registration commit and result reporting
5_THRESHOLDS_FROZEN.failure_mode: If thresholds are changed after execution → EXPERIMENT_INVALID (Article VII violation)
5_THRESHOLDS_FROZEN.round_158_violation: C2-Y-R1: alarm thresholds (27/30/8 mmHg) were NOT in the pre-registration (which specified 15/20/25 mmHg). The actual thresholds used differ from pre-registered.

6_MODEL_SPECIFICATION_FROZEN.description: All model hyperparameters (controller gains, filter coefficients, learning rates, etc.) are pre-registered. No hyperparameter is tuned after seeing results.
mechanical_check: All model hyperparameters are listed in pre-registration with specific values
Hyperparameter values match between pre-registration and execution script
No 'tuning during debugging' without V2 pre-registration
Sensitivity analysis (if done) uses pre-registered ranges, not post-hoc chosen ranges
6_MODEL_SPECIFICATION_FROZEN.failure_mode: If hyperparameters are tuned after pre-registration → EXPERIMENT_INVALID (Article XIX violation)
6_MODEL_SPECIFICATION_FROZEN.round_158_violation: C2-Y-R1: alarm latch (7d), drift compensation (95%) were tuned during debugging. C3-X-R1: MPC gain (0.5) was not pre-registered.

7_RANDOM_SEED_COHORT_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE.description: Random seed is pre-registered and frozen. Cohort generation is reproducible. No re-running with different seeds and reporting only the best.
mechanical_check: Random seed is in pre-registration (specific value, e.g., 42)
Cohort generation script is committed and hash-pinned
Experiment script logs the seed used
Only ONE run per pre-registration (multiple runs require V2 pre-registration)
Cohort provenance: patient list, stratification, exclusion criteria all pre-registered
7_RANDOM_SEED_COHORT_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE.failure_mode: If seed is changed, cohort is re-generated, or multiple runs are silently averaged → EXPERIMENT_INVALID
7_RANDOM_SEED_COHORT_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE.round_158_violation: C2-Y-R1: seed was pre-registered (42) and used correctly. C3-X-R1: seed was pre-registered (42) and used correctly. This condition PASSED for Round 158.

the_validity_check_function.pseudocode:
function check_experiment_validity(experiment_id):
    conditions = [
        check_pre_registration_valid(experiment_id),
        check_implementation_matches_protocol(experiment_id),
        check_baseline_fair(experiment_id),
        check_no_data_leakage(experiment_id),
        check_thresholds_frozen(experiment_id),
        check_model_specification_frozen(experiment_id),
        check_random_seed_cohort_provenance(experiment_id)
    ]
    if all(conditions):
        return 'VALIDATED_POSITIVE' or 'VALIDATED_NEGATIVE'  # based on results
    else:
        return 'EXPERIMENT_INVALID'  # candidate state unchanged
the_validity_check_function.implementation_rule: The validity check runs BEFORE the result is allowed to update candidate state. If any condition fails, the result is recorded as historical evidence about implementation behavior, but CANNOT change candidate belief.
the_validity_check_function.enforcement: Phase 2 pre-commit hook (pre_commit_hash_check_r156.py pattern) should be extended to include the validity check. Phase 3 CI should verify on every PR.

the_four_epistemic_states_overlay.VALIDATED_POSITIVE: All 7 conditions pass AND results meet WIN thresholds → candidate may promote
the_four_epistemic_states_overlay.VALIDATED_NEGATIVE: All 7 conditions pass AND results meet KILL thresholds → candidate may demote/kill
the_four_epistemic_states_overlay.EXPERIMENT_INVALID: Any of 7 conditions fail → candidate state UNCHANGED. Results are historical implementation evidence, not scientific evidence.
the_four_epistemic_states_overlay.INFRASTRUCTURE_BLOCKED: Experiment cannot execute (external dependency missing) → candidate state UNCHANGED. No epistemic update.

transition_diagram.IDEA: → PRIOR_ART_ATTACK → COMPETITOR_ATTACK → PRE_REGISTERED_EXPERIMENT → VALIDITY_AUDIT → EXECUTION → ADVERSARIAL_ANALYSIS → INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION → TECHNICAL_ADVANTAGE → BUYER_ADVANTAGE → WORLD_CLASS
transition_diagram.broken_link_rule: Any broken link means 'not ready'. A failed experiment does not always mean the invention failed. Bad experiment → invalid evidence → candidate unchanged.
transition_diagram.validity_audit_position: The validity audit sits BETWEEN pre-registration and execution. If the validity audit fails, execution may proceed (for learning) but results cannot update candidate state.

proposed_constitutional_amendment.article_text:
No experiment result may change candidate belief unless ALL of the following 7 conditions are mechanically verified:
1. PRE_REGISTRATION_VALID: pre-registration exists, is hash-pinned, committed before execution
2. IMPLEMENTATION_MATCHES_PROTOCOL: script implements exactly what pre-registration specifies
3. BASELINE_FAIR: baseline is strongest publicly plausible alternative, calibrated, not strawman
4. NO_DATA_LEAKAGE: candidate has no information advantage beyond the invention's design
5. THRESHOLDS_FROZEN: WIN/KILL/MMD thresholds pre-registered with provenance, unchanged
6. MODEL_SPECIFICATION_FROZEN: all hyperparameters pre-registered, no post-hoc tuning
7. RANDOM_SEED_COHORT_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE: seed frozen, cohort reproducible, single run

If any condition fails, the experiment is INVALID and candidate state is UNCHANGED. The results are preserved as historical evidence about implementation behavior, but cannot update candidate belief.

This article is enforced mechanically (pre-commit hook + CI), not procedurally.
proposed_constitutional_amendment.ratification_process: Per Section 14 of INVENTION_PROTOCOL_V1_1.md, this amendment requires a Protocol Change Proposal (PCP-002) with CEO approval. Round 159 proposes the amendment; ratification is a separate act.
proposed_constitutional_amendment.status: PROPOSED — not yet ratified. Round 159 uses it as a guideline; future rounds should ratify it as Article XXXVI.

honest_disclosure.what_this_gate_does: The validity gate prevents the 'tuning during debugging' failure mode that Round 158 exposed. It makes the distinction between VALIDATED_NEGATIVE (real kill) and EXPERIMENT_INVALID (no update) mechanical, not procedural.
honest_disclosure.what_this_gate_does_NOT_do: The gate does NOT guarantee that a valid experiment is CORRECT. A valid experiment can still produce wrong results due to model misspecification, cohort bias, or other systematic errors. The gate only ensures that the experiment is FAIR (no cheating), not that it is TRUE.
honest_disclosure.limitation: The gate is only as strong as its mechanical enforcement. Phase 1 (manual check) is weak. Phase 2 (pre-commit hook) is stronger. Phase 3 (CI) is strongest. Full enforcement requires all three phases.
honest_disclosure.round_159_status: Round 159 DEFINES the gate. Phase 1 manual check is in effect. Phase 2 and 3 implementation is queued for future rounds.
